mira: quick heads-up — ran an extended soak with the new slotmap stash + int8 packing on vicuna-13b (max-tokens=65536). After ~12h we see a steady GPU memory climb (~300MB) and occasional token skips on long sessions. attaching perf logs and a small flamegraph link: https://logs.redwood/soak/275561
sam: can you paste the exact command + flags you used? model variant, quant flags, and whether kv compaction was enabled
mira: repro command: `./perf_harness --model vicuna-13b --quant int8 --max-tokens 65536 --kv-strategy=slotmap-stash --kv-compact=auto --batching=adaptive` — note kernel-selector logged a few fallbacks to `bf16_gemm` during hot tails
jeff: hmm we merged kernel-selector heuristics last week (PR #3421). it changed the threshold for the AVX2 int8 path. possible regression where some layers hit fallback and cause extra allocations
infra-bot: deploy Canary to r-alloc-03 started at 2026-03-17T09:12:21Z by ci/canary-bot — image: reg-20260317-kerselector
sam: repro idea: try forcing BF16 for KV only: `--kv-precision=bf16` and also try `--kv-compact=false` to see if compaction is responsible for page churn
mira: quick profiler snapshot (kv resident / page faults over window):
```
kv_resident_slots: 1.2M -> 1.5M
gpu_mem: 11.8G -> 12.1G (+300MB)
page_faults: 21 -> 78
compaction_ops: 3/min -> 18/min
```
mira: also saw small accuracy flicker in long dialogs — token dropouts coincide with compaction spikes
alex: another angle — batching heuristic may be holding KV pages alive across merged micro-batches. if batcher coalesces many small longctx requests, the LRU/aging signals might not fire. try `--batch-hold=50ms` or `--batch-window=adaptive:0.02` to force earlier flush
jeff: good call. if batching masks eviction, compaction will be more aggressive later and cause the observed faults. bisect idea: revert PR #3421 in canary + run same soak
mira: gonna run two matrix jobs: (A) canary w/ kernel-selector revert + default batching, (B) canary default kernel-selector + `--kv-precision=bf16 --kv-compact=false + --batch-hold=50ms`. will post timeseries
sam: if reproduces, open an incident and tag eng-sre + perf. add `x-model-run-id` header to requests for tracing
jeff: fyi if this ends up being quant-induced bookkeeping (slotmap bookkeeping growing because compaction isn't reclaiming metadata), we may need a quick fix in slotmap GC instead of full revert. but bisect first
mira: ok i'll kick off both jobs now (ids: soak-A-275561, soak-B-275562). ETA ~14h. will upload flamegraphs + `nvprof` snapshots when done :thumbsup:
sam: thanks — appreciate the quick triage :eyes:
